description: The active release and the 18 documents it pins. Versions of the three research files are the SHA-256 of the files in this package; the team documents are the examples in examples/config and examples/kit-map.example.json. Illustrative only: not seed data.

documents.name: environment-hazards
documents.basis_summary: Research file. Sourced values with source IDs; edited by the research owner only.

documents.name: routine-schedule
documents.basis_summary: Research file. Sourced cadences and flight surgeon placeholders; edited by the research owner only.

documents.name: responder-flows
documents.basis_summary: Research file. Sourced responder steps; edited by the responder flows owner only.

documents.name: sensor-catalog
documents.basis_summary: Team document. Display ranges and intervals: sourced where cited, otherwise team defaults.

documents.name: sensor-limits
documents.basis_summary: Team document. Values copied from environment-hazards.json; windows and dwell times are team defaults.

documents.name: warning-rules
documents.basis_summary: Team document. Warning definitions; wording from the prototype.

documents.name: routine-rules
documents.basis_summary: Team document. Bindings of routine triggers to events; team defaults.

documents.name: environment-profiles
documents.basis_summary: Team document. Day labels, simulated delays and effect filters; team defaults with sources where given.

documents.name: questionnaires
documents.basis_summary: Team document. Question wording from the prototype.

documents.name: indicator-catalog
documents.basis_summary: Team document. Indicator display and baseline windows; team defaults.

documents.name: help-presentation
documents.basis_summary: Team document. How the help module presents responder-flows.json; team defaults.

documents.name: assistant-policy
documents.basis_summary: Team document. Loop budgets and timeouts; team defaults.

documents.name: ui-copy
documents.basis_summary: Team document. Display words for the fixed vocabulary.

documents.name: participation-rules
documents.basis_summary: Team document. Participation parameters from CONTRACTS section 8.

documents.name: kit-map
documents.basis_summary: Team document. Instruments, supplies, kits and condition rows; every row needs clinical review.

documents.name: onboard-plans
documents.basis_summary: Team document. Plans aboard per condition and flow; sourced lines only, unreviewed.

documents.name: skills-catalog
documents.basis_summary: Team document. Teach steps, landmarks and camera checks; sourced, with team default tolerances.

documents.name: role-rules
documents.basis_summary: Team document. Roles, eligibility and the medical officer cascade; team defaults.
